stench.name: Stench
stench.effect: Tem 10% de chance de fazer o alvo recuar a cada golpe.
stench.effectEn: Has a 10% chance of making target Pokémon flinch with each hit.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.effect: Invoca chuva por tempo indeterminado ao entrar na batalha.
drizzle.effectEn: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

speed-boost.name: Speed Boost
speed-boost.effect: Aumenta a Velocidade em um estágio ao fim de cada turno.
speed-boost.effectEn: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.effect: Evita ser nocauteado com PS cheio, restando 1 PS. Protege contra golpes de nocaute instantâneo, com qualquer PS.
sturdy.effectEn: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead. Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.

damp.name: Damp
damp.effect: Impede o uso de Self-Destruct, Explosion e Aftermath enquanto o Pokémon estiver em batalha.
damp.effectEn: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.

sand-veil.name: Sand Veil
sand-veil.effect: Aumenta a evasão em 1,25 vez durante tempestades de areia e protege contra o dano delas.
sand-veil.effectEn: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

static.name: Static
static.effect: Tem 30% de chance de paralisar quem o atacar por contato.
static.effectEn: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.

volt-absorb.name: Volt Absorb
volt-absorb.effect: Absorve golpes Elétricos e recupera 1/4 do PS máximo.
volt-absorb.effectEn: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

water-absorb.name: Water Absorb
water-absorb.effect: Absorve golpes de Água e recupera 1/4 do PS máximo.
water-absorb.effectEn: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.effect: Impede a paixão e protege contra Captivate.
oblivious.effectEn: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.

cloud-nine.name: Cloud Nine
cloud-nine.effect: Anula todos os efeitos do clima, mas não impede o clima em si.
cloud-nine.effectEn: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.

compound-eyes.name: Compound Eyes
compound-eyes.effect: Aumenta a precisão dos golpes em 1,3 vez.

color-change.name: Color Change
color-change.effect: Muda o próprio tipo para o do golpe de dano que o atingir.
color-change.effectEn: Changes type to match when hit by a damaging move.

flash-fire.name: Flash Fire
flash-fire.effect: Protege contra golpes de Fogo. Depois de bloquear um, os próprios golpes de Fogo causam 1,5 vez mais dano até sair da batalha.
flash-fire.effectEn: Protects against Fire moves. Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.

shield-dust.name: Shield Dust
shield-dust.effect: Protege contra os efeitos adicionais dos golpes recebidos.
shield-dust.effectEn: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.

suction-cups.name: Suction Cups
suction-cups.effect: Impede ser forçado a sair da batalha por golpes de outros Pokémon.
suction-cups.effectEn: Prevents being forced out of battle by other Pokémon's moves.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.effect: Reduz o Ataque dos oponentes em um estágio ao entrar na batalha.
intimidate.effectEn: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

shadow-tag.name: Shadow Tag
shadow-tag.effect: Impede que os oponentes fujam ou sejam trocados.
shadow-tag.effectEn: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.

rough-skin.name: Rough Skin
rough-skin.effect: Causa dano de 1/8 do PS máximo a quem o atacar por contato.
rough-skin.effectEn: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.

wonder-guard.name: Wonder Guard
wonder-guard.effect: Protege contra golpes de dano que não sejam supereficazes.
wonder-guard.effectEn: Protects against damaging moves that are not super effective.

effect-spore.name: Effect Spore
effect-spore.effect: Tem 30% de chance de paralisar, envenenar ou adormecer quem o atacar por contato.
effect-spore.effectEn: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.effect: Devolve queimaduras, paralisia e envenenamento a quem os causou.
synchronize.effectEn: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.

clear-body.name: Clear Body
clear-body.effect: Impede que outros Pokémon reduzam seus atributos.
clear-body.effectEn: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

natural-cure.name: Natural Cure
natural-cure.effect: Cura qualquer problema de status ao ser trocado.
natural-cure.effectEn: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.

lightning-rod.name: Lightning Rod
lightning-rod.effect: Atrai para si golpes Elétricos de alvo único, quando possível. Absorve golpes Elétricos e aumenta o Ataque Especial em um estágio.
lightning-rod.effectEn: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

serene-grace.name: Serene Grace
serene-grace.effect: Dobra a chance de os efeitos adicionais dos golpes acontecerem.
serene-grace.effectEn: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.

chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.effect: Dobra a Velocidade sob sol forte.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.effect: Dobra a taxa de encontros selvagens.

trace.name: Trace
trace.effect: Copia a habilidade de um oponente ao entrar na batalha.
trace.effectEn: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.

poison-point.name: Poison Point
poison-point.effect: Tem 30% de chance de envenenar quem o atacar por contato.
poison-point.effectEn: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.

magnet-pull.name: Magnet Pull
magnet-pull.effect: Impede que oponentes do tipo Aço fujam ou sejam trocados.
magnet-pull.effectEn: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.

rain-dish.name: Rain Dish
rain-dish.effect: Recupera 1/16 do PS máximo ao fim de cada turno na chuva.
rain-dish.effectEn: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.

sand-stream.name: Sand Stream
sand-stream.effect: Invoca uma tempestade de areia por tempo indeterminado ao entrar na batalha.
sand-stream.effectEn: Summons a sandstorm that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.effect: Aumenta em um o custo de PP dos golpes usados contra este Pokémon.
pressure.effectEn: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.

thick-fat.name: Thick Fat
thick-fat.effect: Reduz pela metade o dano de golpes de Fogo e Gelo.
thick-fat.effectEn: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.

early-bird.name: Early Bird
early-bird.effect: Faz o sono passar duas vezes mais rápido.
early-bird.effectEn: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.

flame-body.name: Flame Body
flame-body.effect: Tem 30% de chance de queimar quem o atacar por contato.
flame-body.effectEn: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.

run-away.name: Run Away
run-away.effect: Garante a fuga de batalhas selvagens.
run-away.effectEn: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

hyper-cutter.name: Hyper Cutter
hyper-cutter.effect: Impede que outros Pokémon reduzam seu Ataque.
hyper-cutter.effectEn: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.effect: Recolhe itens usados e arremessados por outros Pokémon. Também pode encontrar um item depois da batalha.
pickup.effectEn: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items. May also pick up an item after battle.

truant.name: Truant
truant.effect: Fica sem agir a cada dois turnos.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.effect: Aumenta o dano dos golpes físicos em 1,5 vez, mas reduz a precisão deles para 0,8 vez.
hustle.effectEn: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.

cute-charm.name: Cute Charm
cute-charm.effect: Tem 30% de chance de apaixonar quem o atacar por contato.
cute-charm.effectEn: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.

plus.name: Plus
plus.effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial em 1,5 vez quando um aliado tem Plus ou Minus.
plus.effectEn: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

minus.name: Minus
minus.effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial em 1,5 vez quando um aliado tem Plus ou Minus.
minus.effectEn: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.effect: Muda o tipo e a forma de Castform de acordo com o clima.
forecast.effectEn: Changes Castform's type and form to match the weather.

sticky-hold.name: Sticky Hold
sticky-hold.effect: Impede que outros Pokémon removam o item que ele segura.
sticky-hold.effectEn: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.

shed-skin.name: Shed Skin
shed-skin.effect: Tem 33% de chance de curar qualquer problema de status ao fim de cada turno.
shed-skin.effectEn: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.

guts.name: Guts
guts.effect: Aumenta o Ataque em 1,5 vez quando tem um problema de status.
guts.effectEn: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

marvel-scale.name: Marvel Scale
marvel-scale.effect: Aumenta a Defesa em 1,5 vez quando tem um problema de status.
marvel-scale.effectEn: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

liquid-ooze.name: Liquid Ooze
liquid-ooze.effect: Causa dano a quem usar golpes de drenagem, igual ao que seria recuperado.
liquid-ooze.effectEn: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.effect: Aumenta o dano dos golpes de Planta em 1,5 vez com 1/3 do PS máximo ou menos.
overgrow.effectEn: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.effect: Aumenta o dano dos golpes de Fogo em 1,5 vez com 1/3 do PS máximo ou menos.
blaze.effectEn: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.effect: Aumenta o dano dos golpes de Água em 1,5 vez com 1/3 do PS máximo ou menos.
torrent.effectEn: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.effect: Aumenta o dano dos golpes de Inseto em 1,5 vez com 1/3 do PS máximo ou menos.
swarm.effectEn: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

drought.name: Drought
drought.effect: Invoca sol forte por tempo indeterminado ao entrar na batalha.
drought.effectEn: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

arena-trap.name: Arena Trap
arena-trap.effect: Impede que os oponentes fujam ou sejam trocados. Tipos Voadores e Pokémon no ar escapam deste efeito.
arena-trap.effectEn: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out. Eluded by Flying-types and Pokémon in the air.

white-smoke.name: White Smoke
white-smoke.effect: Impede que outros Pokémon reduzam seus atributos.
white-smoke.effectEn: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

air-lock.name: Air Lock
air-lock.effect: Anula todos os efeitos do clima, mas não impede o clima em si.
air-lock.effectEn: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.

tangled-feet.name: Tangled Feet
tangled-feet.effect: Dobra a evasão quando está confuso.

motor-drive.name: Motor Drive
motor-drive.effect: Absorve golpes Elétricos e aumenta a Velocidade em um estágio.
motor-drive.effectEn: Absorbs Electric moves, raising Speed one stage.

rivalry.name: Rivalry
rivalry.effect: Aumenta o dano em 1,25 vez contra Pokémon do mesmo gênero, mas reduz para 0,75 vez contra o gênero oposto.
rivalry.effectEn: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.effect: Aumenta a Velocidade em um estágio ao recuar.
steadfast.effectEn: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.

snow-cloak.name: Snow Cloak
snow-cloak.effect: Aumenta a evasão em 1,25 vez durante o granizo e protege contra o dano dele.
snow-cloak.effectEn: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail. Protects against hail damage.

gluttony.name: Gluttony
gluttony.effect: Faz o Pokémon comer a fruta que segura com menos da metade do PS, em vez do limite normal.
gluttony.effectEn: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.

anger-point.name: Anger Point
anger-point.effect: Eleva o Ataque ao máximo de seis estágios ao receber um golpe crítico.
anger-point.effectEn: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.

unburden.name: Unburden
unburden.effect: Dobra a Velocidade ao usar ou perder o item que segura.
unburden.effectEn: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.

heatproof.name: Heatproof
heatproof.effect: Reduz pela metade o dano de golpes de Fogo e de queimaduras.
heatproof.effectEn: Halves damage from Fire moves and burns.

simple.name: Simple
simple.effect: Dobra os modificadores de atributos do Pokémon, ainda limitados a seis estágios para mais ou para menos.
simple.effectEn: Doubles the Pokémon's stat modifiers. These doubled modifiers are still capped at -6 or 6 stages.

dry-skin.name: Dry Skin
dry-skin.effect: Perde 1/8 do PS máximo por turno sob sol forte, mas recupera 1/8 na chuva. Recebe 1,25 vez mais dano de golpes de Fogo e absorve golpes de Água, recuperando 1/4 do PS máximo.
dry-skin.effectEn: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain. Increases damage from Fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

download.name: Download
download.effect: Ao entrar na batalha, aumenta em um estágio o atributo de ataque que explora a defesa mais fraca dos oponentes.
download.effectEn: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.

iron-fist.name: Iron Fist
iron-fist.effect: Aumenta a potência dos socos em 1,2 vez.
iron-fist.effectEn: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.

poison-heal.name: Poison Heal
poison-heal.effect: Quando envenenado, recupera 1/8 do PS máximo a cada turno em vez de perder.
poison-heal.effectEn: Heals for 1/8 max HP after each turn when poisoned in place of damage.

adaptability.name: Adaptability
adaptability.effect: Aumenta o bônus de golpes do mesmo tipo de 1,5 para 2 vezes.
adaptability.effectEn: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.

skill-link.name: Skill Link
skill-link.effect: Golpes de duas a cinco investidas e Triple Kick sempre acertam o número máximo de vezes.
skill-link.effectEn: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and Triple Kick to their full length every time.

hydration.name: Hydration
hydration.effect: Cura qualquer problema de status ao fim de cada turno na chuva.
hydration.effectEn: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

solar-power.name: Solar Power
solar-power.effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial em 1,5 vez, mas perde 1/8 do PS máximo por turno sob sol forte.
solar-power.effectEn: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.

quick-feet.name: Quick Feet
quick-feet.effect: Aumenta a Velocidade em 1,5 vez quando tem um problema de status.
quick-feet.effectEn: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

normalize.name: Normalize
normalize.effect: Faz todos os golpes do Pokémon serem do tipo Normal.
normalize.effectEn: Makes the Pokémon's moves all act Normal-type.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.effect: Golpes críticos causam 3 vezes o dano, em vez de 2.
sniper.effectEn: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.

magic-guard.name: Magic Guard
magic-guard.effect: Protege contra dano que não venha diretamente de um golpe.
magic-guard.effectEn: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.

no-guard.name: No Guard
no-guard.effect: Garante que todos os golpes usados por ele e contra ele acertem.
no-guard.effectEn: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.

stall.name: Stall
stall.effect: Faz o Pokémon agir por último dentro da prioridade do golpe.
stall.effectEn: Makes the Pokémon move last within its move's priority bracket.

technician.name: Technician
technician.effect: Aumenta em 1,5 vez a potência de golpes com 60 de poder base ou menos.
technician.effectEn: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.

leaf-guard.name: Leaf Guard
leaf-guard.effect: Protege contra problemas de status sob sol forte.
leaf-guard.effectEn: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.

klutz.name: Klutz
klutz.effect: Impede o Pokémon de usar em batalha o item que segura.
klutz.effectEn: Prevents the Pokémon from using its held item in battle.

mold-breaker.name: Mold Breaker
mold-breaker.effect: Ignora habilidades dos alvos que poderiam atrapalhar ou impedir um golpe.
mold-breaker.effectEn: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.

super-luck.name: Super Luck
super-luck.effect: Aumenta em um estágio a taxa de golpes críticos.
super-luck.effectEn: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.effect: Causa ao atacante dano de 1/4 do PS máximo dele quando é nocauteado por um golpe de contato.
aftermath.effectEn: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.effect: Ao entrar na batalha, avisa se um oponente tem golpe supereficaz, Self-Destruct, Explosion ou golpe de nocaute instantâneo.
anticipation.effectEn: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.

forewarn.name: Forewarn
forewarn.effect: Revela o golpe mais forte dos oponentes ao entrar na batalha.
forewarn.effectEn: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.

unaware.name: Unaware
unaware.effect: Ignora os modificadores de atributos de outros Pokémon no cálculo de dano e precisão.
unaware.effectEn: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.

tinted-lens.name: Tinted Lens
tinted-lens.effect: Dobra o dano de golpes pouco eficazes.
tinted-lens.effectEn: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.

filter.name: Filter
filter.effect: Reduz em 1/4 o dano recebido de golpes supereficazes.
filter.effectEn: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.

slow-start.name: Slow Start
slow-start.effect: Reduz pela metade o Ataque e a Velocidade por cinco turnos ao entrar na batalha.
slow-start.effectEn: Halves Attack and Speed for five turns upon entering battle.

scrappy.name: Scrappy
scrappy.effect: Permite que golpes Normais e Lutadores atinjam Pokémon Fantasma.
scrappy.effectEn: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.

storm-drain.name: Storm Drain
storm-drain.effect: Atrai para si golpes de Água de alvo único, quando possível. Absorve golpes de Água e aumenta o Ataque Especial em um estágio.
storm-drain.effectEn: Redirects single-target Water moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Water moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

ice-body.name: Ice Body
ice-body.effect: Recupera 1/16 do PS máximo por turno durante o granizo e protege contra o dano dele.
ice-body.effectEn: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail. Protects against hail damage.

solid-rock.name: Solid Rock
solid-rock.effect: Reduz em 1/4 o dano recebido de golpes supereficazes.
solid-rock.effectEn: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.

snow-warning.name: Snow Warning
snow-warning.effect: Invoca granizo por tempo indeterminado ao entrar na batalha.
snow-warning.effectEn: Summons hail that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

honey-gather.name: Honey Gather
honey-gather.effect: Pode encontrar Mel depois da batalha.
honey-gather.effectEn: The Pokémon may pick up Honey after battle.

frisk.name: Frisk
frisk.effect: Revela o item que um oponente segura ao entrar na batalha.
frisk.effectEn: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.effect: Aumenta a potência dos golpes com recuo em 1,2 vez.
reckless.effectEn: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.

multitype.name: Multitype
multitype.effect: Muda o tipo e a forma de Arceus de acordo com a Placa que ele segura.
multitype.effectEn: Changes Arceus's type and form to match its held Plate.

flower-gift.name: Flower Gift
flower-gift.effect: Aumenta em 1,5 vez o Ataque e a Defesa Especial dos aliados sob sol forte.
flower-gift.effectEn: Increases friendly Pokémon's Attack and Special Defense to 1.5× during strong sunlight.

bad-dreams.name: Bad Dreams
bad-dreams.effect: Causa dano de 1/8 do PS máximo por turno a oponentes adormecidos.
bad-dreams.effectEn: Damages sleeping opponents for 1/8 their max HP after each turn.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.effect: Rouba o item de quem o atacar por contato.
pickpocket.effectEn: Steals attacking Pokémon's held items on contact.

sheer-force.name: Sheer Force
sheer-force.effect: Aumenta em 1,3 vez a potência de golpes com efeitos adicionais, mas elimina esses efeitos.
sheer-force.effectEn: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.

unnerve.name: Unnerve
unnerve.effect: Impede que os oponentes comam as frutas que seguram.
unnerve.effectEn: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.

defiant.name: Defiant
defiant.effect: Aumenta o Ataque em dois estágios quando algum atributo é reduzido.
defiant.effectEn: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.

defeatist.name: Defeatist
defeatist.effect: Reduz pela metade o Ataque e o Ataque Especial com 50% do PS máximo ou menos.
defeatist.effectEn: Halves Attack and Special Attack at 50% max HP or less.

cursed-body.name: Cursed Body
cursed-body.effect: Tem 30% de chance de desativar o golpe que atingir este Pokémon.
cursed-body.effectEn: Has a 30% chance of Disabling any move that hits the Pokémon.

healer.name: Healer
healer.effect: Tem 30% de chance de curar problemas de status de cada aliado adjacente ao fim do turno.
healer.effectEn: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.

friend-guard.name: Friend Guard
friend-guard.effect: Reduz para 0,75 vez todo dano direto recebido pelos aliados.
friend-guard.effectEn: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.

weak-armor.name: Weak Armor
weak-armor.effect: Ao ser atingido por um golpe físico, aumenta a Velocidade e reduz a Defesa em um estágio cada.
weak-armor.effectEn: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.

light-metal.name: Light Metal
light-metal.effect: Reduz o peso do Pokémon pela metade.

multiscale.name: Multiscale
multiscale.effect: Reduz pela metade o dano recebido com o PS cheio.
multiscale.effectEn: Halves damage taken from full HP.

toxic-boost.name: Toxic Boost
toxic-boost.effect: Aumenta o Ataque em 1,5 vez quando envenenado.

flare-boost.name: Flare Boost
flare-boost.effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial em 1,5 vez quando queimado.
flare-boost.effectEn: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when burned.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.effect: Tem 50% de chance de recuperar uma fruta usada ao fim do turno, se não estiver segurando outro item.
harvest.effectEn: Has a 50% chance of restoring a used Berry after each turn if the Pokémon has held no items in the meantime.

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.effect: Protege contra golpes de dano dos aliados.
telepathy.effectEn: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.

moody.name: Moody
moody.effect: Ao fim de cada turno, aumenta um atributo aleatório em dois estágios e reduz outro em um.
moody.effectEn: Raises a random stat two stages and lowers another one stage after each turn.

overcoat.name: Overcoat
overcoat.effect: Protege contra dano causado pelo clima.

poison-touch.name: Poison Touch
poison-touch.effect: Tem 30% de chance de envenenar o alvo ao fazer contato.
poison-touch.effectEn: Has a 30% chance of poisoning target Pokémon upon contact.

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.effect: Recupera 1/3 do PS máximo ao ser trocado.
regenerator.effectEn: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

big-pecks.name: Big Pecks
big-pecks.effect: Protege contra a redução da Defesa.

sand-rush.name: Sand Rush
sand-rush.effect: Dobra a Velocidade durante tempestades de areia e protege contra o dano delas.
sand-rush.effectEn: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

wonder-skin.name: Wonder Skin
wonder-skin.effect: Reduz para exatamente 50% a precisão base de golpes sem dano recebidos.
wonder-skin.effectEn: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.

analytic.name: Analytic
analytic.effect: Aumenta a potência dos golpes em 1,3 vez quando age por último.
analytic.effectEn: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.

illusion.name: Illusion
illusion.effect: Assume a aparência do último Pokémon consciente da equipe até ser atingido por um golpe de dano.
illusion.effectEn: Takes the appearance of the last conscious party Pokémon upon being sent out until hit by a damaging move.

infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
infiltrator.effect: Ignora Light Screen, Reflect e Safeguard.
infiltrator.effectEn: Bypasses Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.effect: Transforma a habilidade de quem o atacar por contato em Mummy.
mummy.effectEn: Changes attacking Pokémon's abilities to Mummy on contact.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.effect: Aumenta o Ataque em um estágio ao nocautear um Pokémon.
moxie.effectEn: Raises Attack one stage upon KOing a Pokémon.

justified.name: Justified
justified.effect: Aumenta o Ataque em um estágio ao receber dano de um golpe Sombrio.
justified.effectEn: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.

rattled.name: Rattled
rattled.effect: Aumenta a Velocidade em um estágio ao ser atingido por um golpe Sombrio, Fantasma ou Inseto.
rattled.effectEn: Raises Speed one stage upon being hit by a Dark, Ghost, or Bug move.

magic-bounce.name: Magic Bounce
magic-bounce.effect: Reflete de volta a maioria dos golpes sem dano.
magic-bounce.effectEn: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.

sap-sipper.name: Sap Sipper
sap-sipper.effect: Absorve golpes de Planta e aumenta o Ataque em um estágio.
sap-sipper.effectEn: Absorbs Grass moves, raising Attack one stage.

prankster.name: Prankster
prankster.effect: Aumenta em um estágio a prioridade dos golpes sem dano.
prankster.effectEn: Raises non-damaging moves' priority by one stage.

sand-force.name: Sand Force
sand-force.effect: Sob tempestade de areia, aumenta em 1,3 vez a potência de golpes de Pedra, Terrestres e de Aço, e protege contra o dano dela.
sand-force.effectEn: Strengthens Rock, Ground, and Steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

iron-barbs.name: Iron Barbs
iron-barbs.effect: Causa dano de 1/8 do PS máximo a quem o atacar por contato.
iron-barbs.effectEn: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.

zen-mode.name: Zen Mode
zen-mode.effect: Muda a forma de Darmanitan a cada turno conforme o PS: Modo Zen abaixo de 50% do PS máximo e Modo Padrão no restante.
zen-mode.effectEn: Changes Darmanitan's form after each turn depending on its HP: Zen Mode below 50% max HP, and Standard Mode otherwise.

victory-star.name: Victory Star
victory-star.effect: Aumenta a precisão dos golpes dos aliados em 1,1 vez.
victory-star.effectEn: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.1× for friendly Pokémon.

turboblaze.name: Turboblaze
turboblaze.effect: Ignora habilidades dos alvos que poderiam atrapalhar ou impedir golpes.
turboblaze.effectEn: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.

teravolt.name: Teravolt
teravolt.effect: Ignora habilidades dos alvos que poderiam atrapalhar ou impedir golpes.
teravolt.effectEn: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.

aroma-veil.name: Aroma Veil
aroma-veil.effect: Protege os aliados contra golpes que afetam o estado mental.
aroma-veil.effectEn: Protects allies against moves that affect their mental state.

flower-veil.name: Flower Veil
flower-veil.effect: Protege aliados do tipo Planta de terem os atributos reduzidos por outros Pokémon.
flower-veil.effectEn: Protects friendly Grass Pokémon from having their stats lowered by other Pokémon.

cheek-pouch.name: Cheek Pouch
cheek-pouch.effect: Recupera PS ao comer uma fruta, além do efeito normal dela.
cheek-pouch.effectEn: Restores HP upon eating a Berry, in addition to the Berry's effect.

protean.name: Protean
protean.effect: Muda o próprio tipo para o de cada golpe que usar.
protean.effectEn: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses.

fur-coat.name: Fur Coat
fur-coat.effect: Reduz pela metade o dano de ataques físicos.

magician.name: Magician
magician.effect: Rouba o item do alvo ao usar um golpe de dano.
magician.effectEn: Steals the target's held item when the bearer uses a damaging move.

bulletproof.name: Bulletproof
bulletproof.effect: Protege contra golpes de projétil, bola e bomba.
bulletproof.effectEn: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial em dois estágios quando algum atributo é reduzido.
competitive.effectEn: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

strong-jaw.name: Strong Jaw
strong-jaw.effect: Aumenta a potência das mordidas em 1,5 vez.
strong-jaw.effectEn: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.

refrigerate.name: Refrigerate
refrigerate.effect: Transforma golpes Normais em golpes de Gelo e aumenta a potência deles em 1,3 vez.
refrigerate.effectEn: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Ice moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.

stance-change.name: Stance Change
stance-change.effect: Muda Aegislash para a Forma Lâmina antes de um golpe de dano e para a Forma Escudo antes de King’s Shield.
stance-change.effectEn: Changes Aegislash to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using King’s Shield.

gale-wings.name: Gale Wings
gale-wings.effect: Aumenta em um estágio a prioridade dos golpes Voadores.
gale-wings.effectEn: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.

mega-launcher.name: Mega Launcher
mega-launcher.effect: Aumenta em 1,5 vez a potência de golpes de aura e de pulso.
mega-launcher.effectEn: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.

grass-pelt.name: Grass Pelt
grass-pelt.effect: Aumenta a Defesa enquanto o Terreno de Grama estiver ativo.
grass-pelt.effectEn: Boosts Defense while Grassy Terrain is in effect.

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.effect: Passa o item que segura a um aliado quando ele gasta o próprio item.
symbiosis.effectEn: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.

tough-claws.name: Tough Claws
tough-claws.effect: Aumenta em 1,33 vez a potência de golpes de contato.
tough-claws.effectEn: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.

pixilate.name: Pixilate
pixilate.effect: Transforma golpes Normais em golpes de Fada e aumenta a potência deles em 1,3 vez.
pixilate.effectEn: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Fairy moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.

gooey.name: Gooey
gooey.effect: Reduz a Velocidade de quem o atacar por contato em um estágio.
gooey.effectEn: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.

aerilate.name: Aerilate
aerilate.effect: Transforma golpes Normais em golpes Voadores e aumenta a potência deles em 1,3 vez.
aerilate.effectEn: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Flying moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.

parental-bond.name: Parental Bond
parental-bond.effect: Faz os golpes de dano atingirem duas vezes. O segundo acerto tem metade da potência.
parental-bond.effectEn: Lets the bearer hit twice with damaging moves. The second hit has half power.

dark-aura.name: Dark Aura
dark-aura.effect: Aumenta em 1,33 vez a potência dos golpes Sombrios de todos os Pokémon em campo.
dark-aura.effectEn: Strengthens Dark moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.

fairy-aura.name: Fairy Aura
fairy-aura.effect: Aumenta em 1,33 vez a potência dos golpes de Fada de todos os Pokémon em campo.
fairy-aura.effectEn: Strengthens Fairy moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.

aura-break.name: Aura Break
aura-break.effect: Faz Dark Aura e Fairy Aura enfraquecerem os golpes dos seus tipos.
aura-break.effectEn: Makes Dark Aura and Fairy Aura weaken moves of their respective types.

primordial-sea.name: Primordial Sea
primordial-sea.effect: Cria uma chuva forte, com os efeitos de Rain Dance, que não pode ser substituída e faz golpes de Fogo com dano falharem.
primordial-sea.effectEn: Creates heavy rain, which has all the properties of Rain Dance, cannot be replaced, and causes damaging Fire moves to fail.

desolate-land.name: Desolate Land
desolate-land.effect: Cria um sol extremo, com os efeitos de Sunny Day, que não pode ser substituído e faz golpes de Água com dano falharem.
desolate-land.effectEn: Creates extremely harsh sunlight, which has all the properties of Sunny Day, cannot be replaced, and causes damaging Water moves to fail.

delta-stream.name: Delta Stream
delta-stream.effect: Cria uma misteriosa corrente de ar que não pode ser substituída e impede golpes de serem supereficazes contra Pokémon Voadores.
delta-stream.effectEn: Creates a mysterious air current, which cannot be replaced and causes moves to never be super effective against Flying Pokémon.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.effect: Aumenta a Defesa em um estágio ao receber dano de um golpe.
stamina.effectEn: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.

wimp-out.name: Wimp Out
wimp-out.effect: Este Pokémon é trocado automaticamente quando o PS cai abaixo da metade.
wimp-out.effectEn: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.

emergency-exit.name: Emergency Exit
emergency-exit.effect: Este Pokémon é trocado automaticamente quando o PS cai abaixo da metade.
emergency-exit.effectEn: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.

water-compaction.name: Water Compaction
water-compaction.effect: Aumenta a Defesa em dois estágios ao ser atingido por um golpe de Água.
water-compaction.effectEn: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.

merciless.name: Merciless
merciless.effect: Os golpes deste Pokémon são críticos contra alvos envenenados.
merciless.effectEn: This Pokémon's moves critical hit against poisoned targets.

shields-down.name: Shields Down
shields-down.effect: Transforma Minior entre a Forma Núcleo e a Forma Meteoro. Impede problemas de status e sonolência na Forma Meteoro.
shields-down.effectEn: Transforms this Minior between Core Form and Meteor Form. Prevents major status ailments and drowsiness while in Meteor Form.

stakeout.name: Stakeout
stakeout.effect: Os golpes têm o dobro da potência contra Pokémon que entraram neste turno.
stakeout.effectEn: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.

water-bubble.name: Water Bubble
water-bubble.effect: Reduz pela metade o dano de golpes de Fogo, dobra o dano dos golpes de Água e impede queimaduras.
water-bubble.effectEn: Halves damage from Fire moves, doubles damage of Water moves, and prevents burns.

steelworker.name: Steelworker
steelworker.effect: Os golpes de Aço deste Pokémon têm 1,5 vez mais potência.
steelworker.effectEn: This Pokémon's Steel moves have 1.5× power.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial em um estágio sempre que o PS cai abaixo da metade.
berserk.effectEn: Raises this Pokémon's Special Attack by one stage every time its HP drops below half.

slush-rush.name: Slush Rush
slush-rush.effect: Durante o granizo, este Pokémon tem o dobro da Velocidade.
slush-rush.effectEn: During Hail, this Pokémon has double Speed.

long-reach.name: Long Reach
long-reach.effect: Os golpes deste Pokémon não fazem contato.
long-reach.effectEn: This Pokémon's moves do not make contact.

liquid-voice.name: Liquid Voice
liquid-voice.effect: Golpes sonoros passam a ser do tipo Água.

triage.name: Triage
triage.effect: Aumenta em 3 a prioridade dos golpes de cura deste Pokémon.
triage.effectEn: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.

galvanize.name: Galvanize
galvanize.effect: Os golpes Normais viram Elétricos e têm a potência aumentada em 1,2 vez.
galvanize.effectEn: This Pokémon's Normal moves are Electric and have their power increased to 1.2×.

surge-surfer.name: Surge Surfer
surge-surfer.effect: Dobra a Velocidade no Terreno Elétrico.
surge-surfer.effectEn: Doubles this Pokémon's Speed on Electric Terrain.

schooling.name: Schooling
schooling.effect: Wishiwashi assume a Forma Cardume quando o PS está em 25% ou mais.
schooling.effectEn: Wishiwashi becomes Schooling Form when its HP is 25% or higher.

disguise.name: Disguise
disguise.effect: Evita o primeiro dano sofrido em batalha.
disguise.effectEn: Prevents the first instance of battle damage.

battle-bond.name: Battle Bond
battle-bond.effect: Transforma este Pokémon em Ash-Greninja ao nocautear um oponente. Water Shuriken passa a ter potência 20 e sempre atinge três vezes.
battle-bond.effectEn: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent. Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times.

power-construct.name: Power Construct
power-construct.effect: Transforma Zygarde 10% ou 50% na Forma Completa quando o PS fica abaixo de 50%.
power-construct.effectEn: Transforms 10% or 50% Zygarde into Complete Forme when its HP is below 50%.

corrosion.name: Corrosion
corrosion.effect: Este Pokémon consegue envenenar Pokémon Venenosos e de Aço.
corrosion.effectEn: This Pokémon can inflict poison on Poison and Steel Pokémon.

comatose.name: Comatose
comatose.effect: Este Pokémon age sempre como se estivesse adormecido.
comatose.effectEn: This Pokémon always acts as though it were Asleep.

queenly-majesty.name: Queenly Majesty
queenly-majesty.effect: Os oponentes não podem usar golpes com prioridade.
queenly-majesty.effectEn: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.

innards-out.name: Innards Out
innards-out.effect: Quando desmaia por um golpe, o oponente recebe dano igual ao PS que restava a este Pokémon.
innards-out.effectEn: When this Pokémon faints from an opponent's move, that opponent takes damage equal to the HP this Pokémon had remaining.

dancer.name: Dancer
dancer.effect: Quando outro Pokémon usa um golpe de dança, este Pokémon repete o golpe logo em seguida.
dancer.effectEn: Whenever another Pokémon uses a dance move, this Pokémon will use the same move immediately afterwards.

battery.name: Battery
battery.effect: Aumenta em 1,3 vez a potência dos golpes dos aliados.
battery.effectEn: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.

fluffy.name: Fluffy
fluffy.effect: Reduz pela metade o dano de golpes de contato. Dobra o dano de golpes de Fogo.
fluffy.effectEn: Damage from contact moves is halved. Damage from Fire moves is doubled.

dazzling.name: Dazzling
dazzling.effect: Os oponentes não podem usar golpes com prioridade.
dazzling.effectEn: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.

soul-heart.name: Soul-Heart
soul-heart.effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial em um estágio sempre que um Pokémon desmaia.
soul-heart.effectEn: This Pokémon's Special Attack rises by one stage every time any Pokémon faints.

tangling-hair.name: Tangling Hair
tangling-hair.effect: Ao receber dano de um golpe de contato, reduz a Velocidade do atacante em um estágio.
tangling-hair.effectEn: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.effect: Quando um aliado desmaia, este Pokémon ganha a habilidade dele.
receiver.effectEn: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.

power-of-alchemy.name: Power of Alchemy
power-of-alchemy.effect: Quando um aliado desmaia, este Pokémon ganha a habilidade dele.
power-of-alchemy.effectEn: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.

beast-boost.name: Beast Boost
beast-boost.effect: Aumenta o maior atributo em um estágio ao nocautear outro Pokémon.
beast-boost.effectEn: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.

rks-system.name: RKS System
rks-system.effect: Muda o tipo deste Pokémon de acordo com a Memória que ele segura.
rks-system.effectEn: Changes this Pokémon's type to match its held Memory.

electric-surge.name: Electric Surge
electric-surge.effect: Ao entrar na batalha, muda o terreno para Terreno Elétrico.
electric-surge.effectEn: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Electric Terrain.

psychic-surge.name: Psychic Surge
psychic-surge.effect: Ao entrar na batalha, muda o terreno para Terreno Psíquico.
psychic-surge.effectEn: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain.

misty-surge.name: Misty Surge
misty-surge.effect: Ao entrar na batalha, muda o terreno para Terreno Enevoado.
misty-surge.effectEn: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Misty Terrain.

grassy-surge.name: Grassy Surge
grassy-surge.effect: Ao entrar na batalha, muda o terreno para Terreno de Grama.
grassy-surge.effectEn: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Grassy Terrain.

full-metal-body.name: Full Metal Body
full-metal-body.effect: Outros Pokémon não podem reduzir os atributos deste Pokémon.
full-metal-body.effectEn: Other Pokémon cannot lower this Pokémon's stats.

shadow-shield.name: Shadow Shield
shadow-shield.effect: Com o PS cheio, o dano comum de golpes é reduzido pela metade.
shadow-shield.effectEn: When this Pokémon has full HP, regular damage from moves is halved.

prism-armor.name: Prism Armor
prism-armor.effect: Reduz o dano supereficaz para 0,75 vez.

neuroforce.name: Neuroforce
neuroforce.effect: Aumenta em 1,25 vez o dano supereficaz causado.

libero.name: Libero
libero.effect: Muda o tipo do Pokémon para o do golpe usado anteriormente.
libero.effectEn: Libero changes the Pokémon's type to that of its previously used attack.

ball-fetch.name: Ball Fetch
ball-fetch.effect: Se não estiver segurando um item, busca a Poké Bola do primeiro arremesso que falhou na batalha.
ball-fetch.effectEn: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.

cotton-down.name: Cotton Down
cotton-down.effect: Ignora golpes e habilidades que atraem golpes.
cotton-down.effectEn: When Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.

propeller-tail.name: Propeller Tail
propeller-tail.effect: Ignora golpes e habilidades que atraem golpes.
propeller-tail.effectEn: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.

gulp-missile.name: Gulp Missile
gulp-missile.effect: Quando um Cramorant com Gulp Missile usa Surf ou Dive, ele captura uma presa e muda de forma conforme o PS restante.
gulp-missile.effectEn: If a Cramorant with Gulp Missile uses Surf or Dive, it catches prey and changes its form depending on its remaining HP.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.effect: Ignora golpes e habilidades que atraem golpes.
stalwart.effectEn: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.

steam-engine.name: Steam Engine
steam-engine.effect: Aumenta muito a Velocidade ao ser atingido por um golpe de Fogo ou Água.
steam-engine.effectEn: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

punk-rock.name: Punk Rock
punk-rock.effect: Fortalece golpes sonoros e reduz pela metade o dano recebido deles.
punk-rock.effectEn: Boosts sound-based moves and halves damage from the same moves.

sand-spit.name: Sand Spit
sand-spit.effect: Cria uma tempestade de areia ao ser atingido por um ataque.
sand-spit.effectEn: Creates a sandstorm when hit by an attack.

ice-scales.name: Ice Scales
ice-scales.effect: Reduz pela metade o dano de golpes especiais.

ice-face.name: Ice Face
ice-face.effect: A cabeça de gelo aguenta um ataque físico no lugar do Pokémon, mas muda sua aparência. O gelo volta quando neva.
ice-face.effectEn: The Pokémon’s ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon’s appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.

power-spot.name: Power Spot
power-spot.effect: Estar ao lado deste Pokémon já fortalece os golpes.
power-spot.effectEn: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.effect: Muda de tipo de acordo com o terreno.
mimicry.effectEn: Changes type depending on the terrain.

screen-cleaner.name: Screen Cleaner
screen-cleaner.effect: Anula os efeitos de Light Screen, Reflect e Aurora Veil.
screen-cleaner.effectEn: Nullifies effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil.

steely-spirit.name: Steely Spirit
steely-spirit.effect: Fortalece os golpes de Aço dos aliados.
steely-spirit.effectEn: Powers up ally Pokémon's Steel-type moves.

perish-body.name: Perish Body
perish-body.effect: Ao receber um golpe de contato, este Pokémon e o atacante desmaiam em três turnos, a menos que saiam da batalha.
perish-body.effectEn: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.

wandering-spirit.name: Wandering Spirit
wandering-spirit.effect: Troca de habilidade com os oponentes ao fazer contato.
wandering-spirit.effectEn: Swaps abilities with opponents on contact.

gorilla-tactics.name: Gorilla Tactics
gorilla-tactics.effect: Aumenta o Ataque, mas só permite usar o primeiro golpe escolhido.
gorilla-tactics.effectEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.

neutralizing-gas.name: Neutralizing Gas
neutralizing-gas.effect: Neutraliza as habilidades de todos os Pokémon em batalha.
neutralizing-gas.effectEn: Neutralizes abilities of all Pokémon in battle.

pastel-veil.name: Pastel Veil
pastel-veil.effect: Impede que este Pokémon e seus aliados sejam envenenados.
pastel-veil.effectEn: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from being poisoned.

hunger-switch.name: Hunger Switch
hunger-switch.effect: Faz Morpeko mudar de forma a cada turno, alternando entre Modo Barriga Cheia e Modo Faminto.
hunger-switch.effectEn: Causes Morpeko to change its form each turn, alternating between Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode

quick-draw.name: Quick Draw
quick-draw.effect: Permite agir primeiro de vez em quando.
quick-draw.effectEn: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

unseen-fist.name: Unseen Fist
unseen-fist.effect: Golpes de contato atravessam Protect e Detect.
unseen-fist.effectEn: Contact moves can strike through Protect/Detect.

curious-medicine.name: Curious Medicine
curious-medicine.effect: Zera todas as mudanças de atributos ao entrar em campo.
curious-medicine.effectEn: Resets all stat changes upon entering battlefield.

chilling-neigh.name: Chilling Neigh
chilling-neigh.effect: Aumenta o Ataque depois de nocautear um Pokémon.
chilling-neigh.effectEn: Boosts Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.

grim-neigh.name: Grim Neigh
grim-neigh.effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial depois de nocautear um Pokémon.
grim-neigh.effectEn: Boosts Special Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.

as-one-glastrier.name: As One
as-one-glastrier.effect: Combina os efeitos de Unnerve e Chilling Neigh.
as-one-glastrier.effectEn: Combines the effects of Unnerve and Chilling Neigh.

as-one-spectrier.name: As One
as-one-spectrier.effect: Combina os efeitos de Unnerve e Grim Neigh.
as-one-spectrier.effectEn: Combines the effects of Unnerve and Grim Neigh.

lingering-aroma.name: Lingering Aroma
lingering-aroma.effect: O contato muda a habilidade do atacante para Lingering Aroma.
lingering-aroma.effectEn: Contact changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

seed-sower.name: Seed Sower
seed-sower.effect: Transforma o chão em Terreno de Grama ao ser atingido por um ataque.
seed-sower.effectEn: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

thermal-exchange.name: Thermal Exchange
thermal-exchange.effect: Aumenta o Ataque ao ser atingido por um golpe de Fogo. Não pode ser queimado.
thermal-exchange.effectEn: Raises Attack when hit by a Fire-type move. Cannot be burned.

anger-shell.name: Anger Shell
anger-shell.effect: Quando o PS cai abaixo da metade, reduz a Defesa e a Defesa Especial, mas aumenta o Ataque, o Ataque Especial e a Velocidade.
anger-shell.effectEn: When the Pokémon's HP drops below half, Anger Shell lowers its Defense and Special Defense but its Attack, Special Attack and Speed are raised.

purifying-salt.name: Purifying Salt
purifying-salt.effect: Protege contra problemas de status e reduz pela metade o dano de golpes Fantasma.
purifying-salt.effectEn: Protects from status conditions and halves damage from Ghost-type moves.

well-baked-body.name: Well-Baked Body
well-baked-body.effect: Imune a golpes de Fogo, que aumentam muito sua Defesa.
well-baked-body.effectEn: Immune to Fire-type moves, and Defense is sharply boosted.

wind-rider.name: Wind Rider
wind-rider.effect: Dá imunidade a golpes de vento e aumenta o Ataque em um estágio ao ser atingido por um deles.
wind-rider.effectEn: Gives immunity to wind moves, and causes the Pokémon's Attack to increase by one stage when hit by one.

guard-dog.name: Guard Dog
guard-dog.effect: Aumenta o Ataque se for intimidado e impede ser forçado a sair.
guard-dog.effectEn: Boosts Attack if intimidated, and prevents being forced to switch out.

wind-power.name: Wind Power
wind-power.effect: Ao ser atingido por um golpe de vento, dobra a potência do próximo golpe Elétrico.
wind-power.effectEn: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.

zero-to-hero.name: Zero to Hero
zero-to-hero.effect: Transforma-se na Forma Heroica ao ser trocado.
zero-to-hero.effectEn: Transforms into its Hero Form when switching out.

commander.name: Commander
commander.effect: Entra na boca de um Dondozo aliado, se houver um em campo.
commander.effectEn: Goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field.

electromorphosis.name: Electromorphosis
electromorphosis.effect: Ao ser atingido por um ataque, dobra a potência do próximo golpe Elétrico.
electromorphosis.effectEn: When hit by an attack, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.

protosynthesis.name: Protosynthesis
protosynthesis.effect: Aumenta o maior atributo sob sol forte ou segurando Energia Booster.
protosynthesis.effectEn: Raises highest stat in harsh sunlight, or if holding Booster Energy.

quark-drive.name: Quark Drive
quark-drive.effect: Aumenta o maior atributo no Terreno Elétrico ou segurando Energia Booster.
quark-drive.effectEn: Raises highest stat on Electric Terrain, or if holding Booster Energy.

good-as-gold.name: Good as Gold
good-as-gold.effect: Dá imunidade a golpes de status.

vessel-of-ruin.name: Vessel of Ruin
vessel-of-ruin.effect: Reduz o Ataque Especial de todos os Pokémon, exceto o próprio.
vessel-of-ruin.effectEn: Lowers Special Attack of all Pokémon except itself.

sword-of-ruin.name: Sword of Ruin
sword-of-ruin.effect: Reduz a Defesa de todos os Pokémon, exceto o próprio.
sword-of-ruin.effectEn: Lowers Defense of all Pokémon except itself.

tablets-of-ruin.name: Tablets of Ruin
tablets-of-ruin.effect: Reduz o Ataque de todos os Pokémon, exceto o próprio.
tablets-of-ruin.effectEn: Lowers Attack of all Pokémon except itself.

beads-of-ruin.name: Beads of Ruin
beads-of-ruin.effect: Reduz a Defesa Especial de todos os Pokémon, exceto o próprio.
beads-of-ruin.effectEn: Lowers Special Defense of all Pokémon except itself.

orichalcum-pulse.name: Orichalcum Pulse
orichalcum-pulse.effect: Torna o sol forte ao entrar na batalha e aumenta o Ataque enquanto isso durar.
orichalcum-pulse.effectEn: Turns the sunlight harsh when entering battle, and boosts Attack while active.

hadron-engine.name: Hadron Engine
hadron-engine.effect: Cria Terreno Elétrico ao entrar na batalha e aumenta o Ataque Especial enquanto ele durar.
hadron-engine.effectEn: Creates an Electric Terrain when entering battle, and boosts Special Attack while active.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.effect: Copia os aumentos de atributos do oponente.
opportunist.effectEn: Copies stat boosts by the opponent.

cud-chew.name: Cud Chew
cud-chew.effect: Reutiliza uma fruta já consumida ao fim do turno seguinte.
cud-chew.effectEn: Causes the Pokémon to reuse an already consumed Berry at the end of the next turn.

supreme-overlord.name: Supreme Overlord
supreme-overlord.effect: O Ataque e o Ataque Especial aumentam para cada Pokémon derrotado da equipe.
supreme-overlord.effectEn: Attack and Special Attack are boosted for each party Pokémon that has been defeated.

costar.name: Costar
costar.effect: Copia as mudanças de atributos de um aliado ao entrar na batalha.
costar.effectEn: Copies ally's stat changes on entering battle.

toxic-debris.name: Toxic Debris
toxic-debris.effect: Espalha espinhos venenosos sob os oponentes ao receber dano de golpes físicos.
toxic-debris.effectEn: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

armor-tail.name: Armor Tail
armor-tail.effect: Impede o oponente de usar golpes com prioridade, como Quick Attack.
armor-tail.effectEn: Prevents the opponent from using any moves that have priority, such as Quick Attack.

earth-eater.name: Earth Eater
earth-eater.effect: Recupera PS ao ser atingido por um golpe Terrestre.
earth-eater.effectEn: Restores HP when hit by a Ground-type move.

mycelium-might.name: Mycelium Might
mycelium-might.effect: Golpes de status agem por último, mas não são afetados pela habilidade do oponente.
mycelium-might.effectEn: Status moves go last, but are not affected by the opponent's ability.

minds-eye.name: Mind’s Eye
minds-eye.effect: Ignora a evasão dos oponentes, não pode ter a precisão reduzida e atinge Pokémon Fantasma com golpes Normais e Lutadores.
minds-eye.effectEn: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

supersweet-syrup.name: Supersweet Syrup
supersweet-syrup.effect: Uma vez por batalha, ao entrar em campo, reduz a evasão dos oponentes adjacentes em um estágio.
supersweet-syrup.effectEn: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.

hospitality.name: Hospitality
hospitality.effect: Ao entrar na batalha, recupera 25% do PS de um aliado.
hospitality.effectEn: When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.

toxic-chain.name: Toxic Chain
toxic-chain.effect: Pode envenenar gravemente o oponente ao atingi-lo com um golpe.
toxic-chain.effectEn: May cause bad poisoning when the Pokémon hits an opponent with a move.

embody-aspect.name: Embody Aspect
embody-aspect.effect: Aumenta um atributo específico de acordo com a forma do Ogerpon Terastalizado.
embody-aspect.effectEn: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon

tera-shift.name: Tera Shift
tera-shift.effect: Ao entrar na batalha, Terapagos assume a Forma Terastal até o fim dela.
tera-shift.effectEn: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.

tera-shell.name: Tera Shell
tera-shell.effect: Com o PS cheio, todo golpe de dano recebido será pouco eficaz.
tera-shell.effectEn: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

teraform-zero.name: Teraform Zero
teraform-zero.effect: Assim que assume a Forma Estelar, Terapagos neutraliza os efeitos de clima e terreno.
teraform-zero.effectEn: As soon as Terapagos assumes its Stellar Form, it will immediately neutralize weather and terrain effects.

poison-puppeteer.name: Poison Puppeteer
poison-puppeteer.effect: Pokémon envenenados pelos golpes de Pecharunt também ficam confusos.
poison-puppeteer.effectEn: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

piercing-drill.name: Piercing Drill
piercing-drill.effect: Golpes de contato atingem até alvos que estão se protegendo.
piercing-drill.effectEn: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves.

dragonize.name: Dragonize
dragonize.effect: Os golpes Normais viram golpes de Dragão e têm a potência aumentada em 20%.
dragonize.effectEn: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

mega-sol.name: Mega Sol
mega-sol.effect: Pode usar seus golpes como se houvesse sol forte.
mega-sol.effectEn: The Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

spicy-spray.name: Spicy Spray
spicy-spray.effect: Queima o atacante ao receber dano de um golpe.
spicy-spray.effectEn: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

eelevate.name: Eelevate
eelevate.effect: Flutua acima do chão e fica imune a golpes Terrestres, Spikes, Toxic Spikes e Sticky Web. Ao nocautear um alvo, seu maior atributo aumenta em 1 estágio.
eelevate.effectEn: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

fire-mane.name: Fire Mane
fire-mane.effect: Aumenta em 50% a potência dos golpes de Fogo do Pokémon.
fire-mane.effectEn: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.

aura-guard.name: Aura Guard
aura-guard.effect: Recebe metade do dano de golpes de contato.
aura-guard.effectEn: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact.
